item.title: Show HN: Martin, A CLI that let's your Agent be your CRM, Built on Jaybase
item.summary: Hi HN, In my continued quest to excape App Hell, unify all my business data, and let AI run the the parts of my business that don't make money, I've built Martin. Martin is a CLI that let's your store all your customer data in Jaybase, which is an append only business facts DB I built (link at the end). It works along side my bookkeeping CLI, Martin, so now I have a single, AI Native source of truth where I can see the entire customer journey from lead through to customer in one place, not smeared over 3 different apps asking for a subscription. Would love to get your thoughts! Links to Jaybase: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=48999936 and Magpie: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49091292 Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49202363 Points: 2 # Comments: 0
